charts.title: HIP 29442 d: orbits around HIP 29442
charts.description: The orbits of HIP 29442's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HIP 29442 d highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Egger et al. 2024 (2024A&A...688A.223E), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname EGGER_ET_AL__2024): P 6.429575 d

charts.title: HIP 29442 d: its transit
charts.description: HIP 29442 d crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (6, 33, 87) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 33692729, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 4 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 29 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 12-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 4 min early; 12-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 10 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
